SALES_COMPARISON._CurrentSalesAgreementAnalysisComment: According to public assessment records (geodataplus) the subject unit has not transferred within the past 36 months. In addition none of the first four (4) comparable sales transfered except what was indicated on the comparable sales grid above. We will note that comparable sales 1, 2, 3 and 4 were closed sales whereas comp 5 was an active listing and currently under contract. Comparable sale 1 is located within the subject condominium complex, whereas comparable sales 2, 3, 4 and 5 were situated outside the subject condominium complex.
SALES_COMPARISON._Comment: The subject along with the five comparable sales are similar sized studio condominium units located within condominium buildings within Manhattan. We adjusted the comparable sales where differences existed such as variance in gross living area (GLA) by a factor of $200.00 PSF. Floor level was adjusted by $2,000 per floor. Deeded parking for comparable 4 and 5 was adjusted by $60,000. The subject unit was rated in overall GOOD condition on the date of inspection. All four comparable sales are rated in similar C2: Good condition. We noted a limited number of similar comparable condominium sales similar to the subject in age, design and appeal requiring us to utilize four comparable sales outside the subject condominium project. Comparable sale 1 was located within the subject condominium complex, whereas comparable sales 2, 3, 4 and 5 were situated outside the subject condominium complex. We will note that all five comparable sales were larger than the subject unit. Having said this, the subject's smaller unit size does not affect marketability. We utilized the paired sales analysis when arriving at an adjusted sale price. In our final analysis we placed greatest emphasis on comparable sales 1, 2 and 3 when arriving at an estimate of value for the subject unit.

_RECONCILIATION._SummaryComment: In our final analysis we placed greatest emphasis on comparable sales 1, 2 and 3 in the sales comparison approach to value. We noted that there were a very limited number of similar comparable condominium sales similar to the subject in age, design and market appeal requiring us to utilize other comparable type units. We will note that there were no other recent comparable sale (other than comp 1) which were sold and closed within the subject condominium building which could be utilized for valuation purposes. We will note that comparable 4 was an active listing which just entered contract on 07/2026. Having said this, all five comparable sales offered similarities relative to the subject which include similar location, design, appeal and gross living area (GLA). Exposure marketing time for the subject property is determined to be within a 3-6 month period.
